name: Jared Gonzales
office: Beverly Hills Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Jared Gonzales teaches seventh- and eighth-grade math at Yavneh Hebrew Academy in West Los Angeles. He previously taught at Harkham Hillel Hebrew Academy and began his career with Teach for America. His campaign priorities are student academic success, safety and wellness, and board governance. At a student forum, he said he moved his classes to pencil and paper to improve focus but wants BHUSD to prepare students for AI. He said he would hold office hours for students. In a questionnaire, he called the district's technology policy a step forward but would end one-to-one devices for sixth and seventh graders. He wants AI to enhance critical thinking and has proposed mentorship programs for in-person interaction.
